contradictions.what: Tom first names Raj as final decider, then says Angela signed with Adyen and 'Probably Angela' made the call.
Raj was the contact 'the whole way', but the actual signer Angela was met only once at kickoff.
Tom says 'we were ahead' per Raj, yet customer questions had shifted heavily to stores, where we were weak.
Pitch leaned on unified commerce, but the customer's need was concrete store returns; we only described, never showed.
Tom says he knew it was lost at the workshop but also says we were ahead right before; lead rested on web only.
